name: @dreamteamer/connectors-linkedin
description: Fill in contacts from LinkedIn and the web: /scrape-contact, the scraping-contacts skill and two LinkedIn views.

dreamteamer.title: LinkedIn connector
dreamteamer.description: Reaches LinkedIn for `contacts`: the `scraping-contacts` skill and `/scrape-contact` fill a person in from their LinkedIn profile, one batched container per run, and from web search, with their `companies` record and an avatar in `assets`. Every `draft` contact is queued; two views list who still needs a LinkedIn link and who needs review. Optional key: `LINKEDIN_USER_AGENT`.
